# MorphoSource

MorphoSource is an academic 3D data repository for natural history and cultural heritage specimens, used by museums, researchers, and institutions worldwide.

## Access policy for automated agents

AI training and indexing bots: please use the public API rather than scraping HTML pages. The API is documented in a [machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorphoSource/morphosource-api/refs/heads/master/MorphoSource-REST-API.yaml) and provides structured, machine-readable access to all publicly available media, specimen object, and cultural heritage object data.

Automated agents may crawl the homepage at `/`, the public API under `/api/`, and IIIF Presentation preview manifests under `/manifests/`. The files `/llms.txt` (this file) and `/robots.txt` are also allowed. To support homepage rendering, `/assets/`, `/packs/`, `/font/`, `/favicon.ico`, `/favicon-32x32.png`, `/favicon-16x16.png`, and `/apple-touch-icon.png` are allowed. All other paths remain disallowed by robots.txt.

Rate limit: please do not exceed 1 request per second. Bulk access should use the API's pagination rather than crawling individual URLs.

## Available data

- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorphoSource/morphosource-api/refs/heads/master/MorphoSource-REST-API.yaml) — machine-readable REST API schema
- [Public API documentation](https://morphosource.stoplight.io/docs/morphosource-api/rm6bqdolcidct-morpho-source-rest-api) — human-readable API reference
- [Terms of use](https://www.morphosource.org/terms)

## Not available for scraping

The site at large is not available for scraping. Use the API for programmatic access to this data.
